headline: Fortinet tops guidance and lifts its full-year outlook
summary_short: Fortinet's Q2 2026 revenue rose 26% y/y to $2,047.9M, exceeding the high end of its own guidance, with GAAP diluted EPS up 44% y/y to $0.82 and non-GAAP operating margin at 38%.
summary_long: Second-quarter revenue grew 26% y/y to $2,047.9M, driven by product revenue's 52% y/y jump to $773.0M versus 14% y/y growth in service revenue; billings rose 33% y/y to $2,372.1M. GAAP operating margin expanded to 33.7% from 28.1% y/y as revenue growth outpaced an 11% rise in operating expenses; non-GAAP operating margin was 38.0%. Net income rose 38% y/y to $606.3M, and diluted EPS grew 44% y/y to $0.82, aided by a 4.2% lower diluted share count from continued buybacks ($972.8M repurchased in H1). Fortinet raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $8.020B-$8.180B (19% y/y growth) and issued Q3 2026 guidance of $2.010B-$2.100B revenue. Cash rose to $2,934.9M even after repaying $500M of senior notes.
